senses.sense_definition: A transparent block, typically with triangular ends, used to refract light into a spectrum of colors.

examples.text: The student used a glass <w>prism</w> to split the white light into a rainbow.
Light passing through the <w>prism</w> revealed all the colors of the spectrum.

senses.sense_definition: A solid geometric shape with two identical, parallel ends and flat, parallelogram-shaped sides.

examples.text: The geometry teacher asked the class to calculate the volume of the triangular <w>prism</w>.
A rectangular <w>prism</w> is a common shape for many cardboard boxes.

senses.sense_definition: A particular perspective or viewpoint through which one interprets or experiences events.

examples.text: She viewed the political crisis through the <w>prism</w> of her own personal experiences.
We must analyze these historical events through the <w>prism</w> of modern social values.

senses.sense_definition: A reflective device used in surveying to bounce a light beam back to a measuring instrument.

examples.text: The surveyor placed the <w>prism</w> on the pole to mark the exact location.
The total station measures distance by timing the light reflected from the <w>prism</w>.
